agents.name: Claude Code

secrets.label: Claude subscription token (run claude setup-token on this Mac)

agents.setup: if [ -n "${CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then (umask 077; f="$HOME/.claude.json"; [ -e "$f" ] || printf '{}' > "$f"; /usr/bin/jq '.hasCompletedOnboarding = true' "$f" > "$f.avm" 2>/dev/null && /bin/mv "$f.avm" "$f" || /bin/rm -f "$f.avm"); fi
agents.login: Or log in inside a kept box: /login in Claude Code, then open the address it prints in this Mac's browser.
agents.note: Your Claude login on this Mac is not visible in the box.

agents.name: Codex
agents.login: Or log in inside a kept box: codex login --device-auth, and enter the code in this Mac's browser (works with a ChatGPT account).

agents.name: opencode
agents.note: OpenCode Zen's free models need no account. Other providers need their key (--secret) and their hosts (box network --allow).
